# Volume 2 timeline

## I An Irate Neighbor

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Dolly](../character/dolly.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is interrupted while daydreaming by Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), their angry neighbor, who complains that her cow has broken into his oats. After a heated argument, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) pen-up the cow, and later discusses the incident and local gossip with [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P28](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0028), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P38](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0038)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) expresses skepticism about Stephen Irving's son coming to live in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and warns [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) against starting a Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) defends her plans for the society and learns that her friend [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) has been hired to teach at [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) school.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P47](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0047), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P50](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0050), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P54](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0054), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P58](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0058)_

## II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Dolly](../character/dolly.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Martin](../character/martin.md), [Shearer](../character/shearer.md)** — While returning from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) spot a cow ruining Mr. Harrison's oat field. Believing it to be her own unruly cow, [Dolly](../character/dolly.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) hastily sells the animal to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md) on the spot. Upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers [Dolly](../character/dolly.md) safe in her pen and realizes she accidentally sold Mr. Harrison's cow instead.

_Sources: [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P12](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0012), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P23](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0023), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P24](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0024), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P35](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0035)_

## III Mr. Harrison at Home

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to Mr. Harrison's house to confess that she accidentally sold his Jersey cow to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md). To her relief, Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) takes the news calmly and agrees to accept Anne's cow in exchange. They share tea and cake, bonding despite insults from Mr. Harrison's foul-mouthed parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to share the happy outcome with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

_Sources: [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P20](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0020), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P23](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0023), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P35](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0035), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P53](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0053)_

## IV Different Opinions

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) discuss their different philosophies on teaching and discipline the evening before the school term begins. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) then visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who also doubts her plan to avoid corporal punishment. The next morning, a nervous [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares for her first day of teaching with encouragement and ginger tea from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

_Sources: [v2 IV Different Opinions P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 IV Different Opinions P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007), [v2 IV Different Opinions P35](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0035), [v2 IV Different Opinions P41](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0041)_

## V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), Cottons, [Prillie Rogerson](../character/prillie-rogerson.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) begins her first day teaching at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, observing her new pupils and forming a quick bond with [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) while struggling with [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md). After school, Mrs. H. B. Donnell confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) over the pronunciation of her family's name and her son's name. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home feeling relieved after [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) gives her flowers, and she later discusses the day with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021)_

## VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Catherine Andrews](../character/catherine-andrews.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md), [Eben Wright](../character/eben-wright.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drive along the [Newbridge](../codex/places.md#newbridge) road to canvass for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). They stop at the Andrews house, where the pessimistic [Eliza](../character/eliza-andrews.md) refuses to give anything, but Catherine secretly runs out afterward to contribute her egg money.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P0](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0000), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P12](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0012), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P16](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0016), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P30](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0030)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), Carmody, [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) continue their fundraising canvass, encountering various quirky neighbors including the neat freak Mrs. Theodore White and the overjoyed [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md), who donates handsomely following the birth of his son. Later that evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) to ask for a subscription, but he flatly refuses.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P40](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0040), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P49](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0049), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P55](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0055), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P57](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0057)_

## VII The Pointing of Duty

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) while she is writing and studying, and the two talk about their teaching experiences and future aspirations. After [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) leaves, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home and discusses the dying Mrs. Keith and her twins, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to persuade [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to take the children in.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P1](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0001), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P12](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0012), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P23](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0023), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P33](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0033)_

## VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

**[Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Lauretta](../character/lauretta.md), [Allan](../character/allan.md), Aid Society** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) brings the orphaned twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) quickly proves to be a handful, getting into trouble by dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck in church and pumping water over [Dora](../character/dora.md) after coaxing her into a pigpen. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attempts to gently guide [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) while removing a toad he hid in Marilla's bed.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he put a toad in Marilla's bed after complaining about [Dora](../character/dora.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) quickly sneaks into Marilla's room and carries the toad out to the cherry orchard on a fire shovel before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) notices.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P56](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0056), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P61](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0061), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P62](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0062)_

## IX A Question of Color

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [John Andrew](../character/john-andrew.md), [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Oliver Sloane](../character/oliver-sloane.md), [Peter Sloane](../character/peter-sloane.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Roger Pye](../character/roger-pye.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and the village hall project with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). After the painter finishes, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discovers that the hall has been painted a glaring blue instead of green due to a mix-up with the paint order numbers. The news spreads, devastating the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), but the villagers rally behind the young people while blaming the [Pyes](../codex/factions.md#pyes) for the mistake.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P25](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0025), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040)_

## X Davy in Search of a Sensation

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns from school enjoying the autumn day until [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reveals that [Dora](../character/dora.md) is missing. After a frantic search and dragging the well, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds [Dora](../character/dora.md) locked in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse. [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses he trapped her there and lied about it, but breaks down when he realizes lying is wrong, leading [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to punish and educate him.

_Sources: [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P9](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0009), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P34](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0034), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P52](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0052)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) confronts [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) about his dishonesty and his decision to test Marilla's warning by skipping his prayers. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares the story with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) downstairs, and the two discuss Davy's mischief compared to Dora's good behavior, agreeing that they both feel a special affection for [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) despite his faults.

_Sources: [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P70](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0070), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P75](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0075), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P81](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0081), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P88](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0088)_

## XI Facts and Fancies

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Nora](../character/nora.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md), [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailors.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) writes a letter to her friend [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) detailing her experiences teaching at [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, sharing funny student remarks and compositions. She recounts how [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md) admitted to copying love letters for her assignment and highlights a imaginative letter written by her favorite pupil, [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md).

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P9](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0009), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P26](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0026), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)_

**[Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)** — [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) writes a letter describing his imaginary rock people—including [Nora](../character/nora.md), the [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailors.md), and the [Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md)—and recounts a fantastical trip to the sunset land in an enchanted boat. He concludes the letter with a postscript clarifying that it is not actually true.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P44](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0044), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P46](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0046)_

## XII A Jonah Day

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Chester Sloane](../character/chester-sloane.md), [Clair Donnell](../character/clair-donnell.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Joe Sloane](../character/joe-sloane.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Prillie Rogerson](../character/prillie-rogerson.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — In a miserable mood caused by a toothache, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has a terrible day at school, accidentally causing firecrackers to explode in the stove and losing her temper enough to whip [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) for putting a mouse in her desk. That evening, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comforts a remorseful [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). To Anne's surprise, the punishment earns Anthony's respect, as later confirmed when he behaves pleasantly and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) shares his approval.

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P19](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0019), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P40](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0040), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050)_

## XIII A Golden Picnic

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) invites [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to celebrate her spring "adopted birthday" with a picnic walk through the woods with [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md). On Saturday, the four girls explore new paths, name a woodland pool "[Crystal Lake](../codex/places.md#crystal-lake)," and discover the forgotten, flower-filled garden of [Hester Gray](../character/hester-gray.md). Sitting among the narcissi, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) shares the poignant story of Hester's life and death, which deeply touches [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P1](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0001), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P3](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0003), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P29](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0029), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P44](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0044)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) discuss Hester Gray's life and garden while enjoying a picnic outdoors. They share their poetic thoughts on nature and souls before returning home in the evening.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P56](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0056), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P61](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0061), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P66](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0066), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P73](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0073)_

## XIV A Danger Averted

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), Improvers, [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Oliver Sloane](../character/oliver-sloane.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) catches [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) stealing plum jam and lectures him, before learning with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that the twins will remain at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) until fall. Later at an [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting, [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md) announces that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) plans to rent his fence to a patent-medicine company for advertisements. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visit Judson to persuade him otherwise, but he smoothly refuses to change his mind.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P18](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0018), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md), [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md), [Oliver Sloane](../character/oliver-sloane.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) fail to persuade [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) to keep patent medicine ads off his fences. However, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later catches Judson accepting a political bribe from [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md) near the [Lake of Shining Waters](../codex/places.md#lake-of-shining-waters). Fearful that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) will expose him and ruin his reputation, Judson agrees to drop the fence advertisements if she keeps quiet.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P58](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0058), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P61](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0061), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P65](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0065)_

## XV The Beginning of Vacation

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Allan](../character/allan.md)** — As the school year ends, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks to the graveyard with [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), discussing his mother's memory, his life with his grandmother, and their imaginative worlds. At the graveyard, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaves flowers for [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Hester Gray](../character/hester-gray.md) before walking home with Mrs. Allan, who offers encouraging advice about teaching, ideals, and friendship.

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P2](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0002), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P26](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0026), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P33](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0033)_

## XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a letter announcing that famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) will be visiting [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). She excitedly prepares a special menu, cleans the house meticulously, and enlists the help of [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) for the event.

_Sources: [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P14](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0014), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P16](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0016), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P24](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0024), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P28](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0028)_

## XVII A Chapter of Accidents

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Morgan](../character/morgan.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) eagerly decorate [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and prepare a elaborate dinner for the arrival of famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and other guests. A series of mishaps ensues: [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) ruins the lemon pies, Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) fails to show up, the peas are ruined by too much sugar, and Miss Barry's expensive platter gets broken. A letter from [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) later explains that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) sprained her ankle, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) disappointed but resilient.

_Sources: [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P10](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0010), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P57](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0057), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P62](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0062)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — After their guests leave, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) clean up, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later receives a letter from [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) explaining that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) cannot visit [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) due to an injury. Sitting on the porch, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss the day's disappointments, how to resolve the broken platter, and neighborhood gossip before [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) arrives.

_Sources: [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P62](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0062), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P63](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0063), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P65](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0065), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P79](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0079)_

## XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Sarah](../character/sarah.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) puts [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) to bed after answering his curious questions about sleep and jam. Later, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) signals [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) from [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) and tells her where they might find a willow-ware platter to replace Aunt Josephine's. The next day, the two girls drive to the Copp farm on [Tory Road](../codex/places.md#tory-road), where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally falls through the roof of a duck house while trying to look in the pantry window, leaving her stuck until Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) Copp returns and releases her.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P0](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0000), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P15](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0015), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P34](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0034), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P55](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0055)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Sarah](../character/sarah.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) explains her pantry intrusion to Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md), who serves the girls tea and agrees to sell the willow-ware platter for twenty-five dollars to help fund her upcoming wedding. After leaving, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) holds her new purchase while she and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) discuss the day's adventures on their ride home.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P59](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0059), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P62](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0062), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P63](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0063), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P64](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0064)_

## XIX Just a Happy Day

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) while his grandmother is away, having tea with him and listening to his imaginative thoughts. Later at home, she puts a jealous [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) to bed and reassures him of her affection. Afterwards, she meets [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) near the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble) and reflects on how mature he has become.

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P2](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0002), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P23](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0023), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P34](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0034), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) bedtime-talks with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about trying to be good, after which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) near the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble) to discuss their village improvement society's progress and upcoming plans. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and chats with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about her busy schedule for the next day.

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P47](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0047), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P55](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0055), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P61](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0061)_

## XX The Way It Often Happens

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Morgan](../character/morgan.md), [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) leaves [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for town with [Dora](../character/dora.md) while [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) goes off with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to do chores. While [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is changing a feather bed, [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) unexpectedly arrives with famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md). Despite accidentally dyeing her nose red with rug dye beforehand, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) manages to clean herself up, borrow food from [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and entertain her guests with a pleasant dinner and a walk through the woods.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P20](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0020), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P36](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0036), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P43](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0043)_

## XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Milty Boulter](../character/milty-boulter.md), [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md)** — At school, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) gets into a dispute over a picture drawn on a slate, while [Dora](../character/dora.md) becomes frightened of staying in the dark after [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) shares stories of her family's ghosts. Later in October, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) get lost in the woods on their way to a tea party and stumble upon [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). There they meet the eccentric Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her maid [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), who invite them to stay for tea.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md)** — Miss Lavendar entertains [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and Charlotta the Fourth with tea and demonstrates the magical echoes around [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). After explaining the history of her succession of 'Charlottas,' Miss Lavendar is shaken when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) casually mentions [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), the son of her former lover, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). The girls bid a warm farewell to a visibly saddened Miss Lavendar and reflect on her and their own names as they leave.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P64](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0064), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P71](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0071), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P81](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0081), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P87](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0087)_

## XXII Odds and Ends

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — At the breakfast table, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) repeatedly scolds [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) for his poor table manners. Later, news arrives that the twins' uncle, [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md), has passed away and left money for their care, securing their future at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P0](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0000), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P4](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0004), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P25](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0025)_

## XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Irving](../character/irving.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks through the woods to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to spend an evening with Miss Lavendar while Charlotta the Fourth is away. Over tea and candy, Miss Lavendar confides in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her past romance and broken engagement with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). A month later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) brings Stephen's son, [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), to meet Miss Lavendar, and the two quickly bond.

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P4](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0004), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P15](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0015), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P26](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0026)_

## XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Uncle Abe](../character/uncle-abe.md)** — Uncle Abe's weather prediction unexpectedly comes true when a destructive hail and lightning storm strikes [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), severely damaging crops, trees, and buildings. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and the twins weather the fury of the tempest at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) before assessing the community-wide destruction, which includes the loss of Mr. Harrison's parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P33](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0033), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043)_

## XXV An Avonlea Scandal

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Emily](../character/emily.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) speaks with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) when a well-dressed woman arrives in a wagon looking for Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). The visitor reveals she is Mr. Harrison's wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), and leaves to go to his house. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss the surprise, and later [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) add further details about Emily's return.

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P9](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0009), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P25](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0025), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Emily](../character/emily.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) explains to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) the background of his marital separation and how his late parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md) led to their split before [Emily](../character/emily.md) returned. Mrs. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) walks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back toward [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), expressing her own regrets about being too hasty, while Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discusses the Harrisons with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P58](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0058), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P65](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0065), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P67](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0067)_

## XXVI Around the Bend

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md)** — After [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md) passes away, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) proposes that [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to live with her. This arrangement would free [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to resign from her teaching position and attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) in the fall.

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P23](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0023), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md)** — [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) expresses her anxieties about [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) moving away to [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), including her fear of being left behind and her curiosity regarding Anne's feelings for [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reassures [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) of her enduring love and friendship, reflecting fondly on how much Diana's presence changed her life since coming to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P45](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0045), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P46](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0046), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P60](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0060), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P61](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0061)_

## XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)** — At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dresses up to visit Miss Lavendar, leading to a humorous dinner conversation with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), and [Dora](../character/dora.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) walk to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where they enjoy lunch, test the echoes, and chat in the garden with Miss Lavendar and Charlotta the Fourth.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P1](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0001), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P31](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0031)_

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)** — While picking berries, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) confides her worries about Miss Lavendar's melancholic mood to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to plan an extended visit during her vacation to cheer her up. After returning to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for tea, Miss Lavendar and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) share a tender conversation about their shared imagination and dream-people before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) depart.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P49](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0049), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P51](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0051), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P62](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0062)_

## XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and helps Miss Lavendar make a new dress before visiting [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). There, she meets Paul's father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), who asks her to carry a message to Miss Lavendar about visiting her. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivers the note and helps an excited Miss Lavendar prepare for Stephen's arrival.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P17](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0017), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057)_

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md)** — [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) arrives at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to visit Miss Lavendar. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) greets him on the porch and ushers him into the parlor to meet Miss Lavendar. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) spot Stephen and Miss Lavendar walking together affectionately in the garden, confirming their joyful reconciliation.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P59](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0059), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P64](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0064), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P70](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0070), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P71](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0071)_

## XXIX Poetry and Prose

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) busies herself helping Miss Lavendar prepare for her upcoming wedding while receiving visits from [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and Charlotta the Fourth. Later, after discussing the romantic nature of the match with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stumbles upon [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) embracing in the [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) garden. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) then visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to officially announce her engagement, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reflect on love and her own romantic ideals.

_Sources: [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P1](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0001), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P15](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0015)_

## XXX A Wedding at the Stone House

**[Allan](../character/allan.md), [Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Irving](../character/irving.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md)** — Miss Lavendar and [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) are married at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) in a lovely ceremony attended by their friends. After seeing the newlyweds off, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) finish tidying the house, where a brief romantic spark between them hints at the changing chapter of Anne's life.

_Sources: [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P33](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0033), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P40](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0040)_
